materials.description: ONE seamless repeatable albedo material tile for the actual 3D environment: irregular pale warm-grey limestone courtyard paving, 6 to10 small stones across each tile, restrained chipped bevels, varied stone sizes, thin grey mortar and sparse moss in joints. Each stone has subtle crafted three-tone mineral mottling and tiny wear marks, not a flat diagram or noisy speckles. Match the fine pixel craftsmanship and material character of the approved Google Drive village concept. Native128x128 refined pixel art with coherent clean clusters and subtle intrinsic surface variation; fill the complete square edge-to-edge with equally detailed edges. Both axes repeat seamlessly. Flat overhead or orthographic material scan, neutral even diffuse lighting, no cast shadows or large painted light gradients, no perspective, scene, border, padding, labels, object silhouette or sheet. No thick black outlines. Same pixel-art family as compact JRPG characters, not photographic noise.
